title: Map60 to Map80 route using the max-level profile

attempts.result: Map60 reached from Map61, then the route helper stopped before trying the Map80 gate because it targeted the inaccessible north approach [24,27]. The live hero remained on Map60 at [1,2] with full HP.
Starting on Map60 at [1,2], the corrected route walks to the south approach [24,29] and enters the Map80 marker with ArrowUp. Map80 is reached at [10,18].

limits: This verifies a max-level route to Map80 from the observed Map60 arrival only.
The ordinary-level M840 Map80 attempt limit remains unchanged.
No service transaction or J2ME comparison was made; see M878 for Map80 menu handoffs.
